# Skill: Git Commit

## Purpose
Stages and commits generated requirement files to the git repository.

## Description
Stages and commits generated requirement files to the git repository.

## Trigger
Used by: Requirement Analysis Agent - Step 6 (Commit Changes).

## Requires
- File path(s) generated by `requirements-doc-writer.skill.md`.
- Git repository initialized in the workspace.

## Output Location
Git repo working tree

## Template
```bash
git add <path-to-requirements.md>

# Verify staged diff is as expected (no unintended files).

git diff --cached

# Commit with message:
# "docs(requirements): capture requirements for <JIRA-ID> - <short title>"

git commit -m "docs(requirements): capture requirements for <JIRA-ID> - <short title>"
```

## Steps
1. `git add <path-to-requirements.md>`
2. Verify staged diff is as expected (no unintended files).
3. Commit with message:
   ```
   docs(requirements): capture requirements for <JIRA-ID> - <short title>
   ```
4. Optionally push, only if the user has explicitly asked to push/publish. Otherwise leave the commit local for review.
5. Report the commit hash and message back to the user.

## Guardrails
- Never force-push.
- Never commit unrelated/ uncommitted files from the working tree — only stage the requirement doc(s) produced in this run.
- If the git working tree has conflicts or a detached HEAD, stop and inform the user instead of proceeding.
